title: Specified compact-support source comparison for an equal factored chart
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to Y$, $s:U\hookrightarrow X$, $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$, $i:U\hookrightarrow P$ and $p:P\to V$ be morphisms of Noetherian schemes, with $s,v$ open, $i$ closed and a specified equality $fs=vpi$. Suppose every displayed morphism and its composites are separated of finite type and admit chosen compactifications. Work in the ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with compact supports [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Let $n_s,n_v,n_i$ be the specified bounded-below immersion normalizations [lem-sf-etale-immersion-shriek-normalization] and let $\alpha_{b,a}:Rb_!Ra_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(ba)_!$ be the canonical bounded-below compositors [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. There is a natural isomorphism, evaluated in the ambient unbounded category only on $H\in D^+(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $$\gamma_H:Rf_!Ds_!H\xrightarrow{\sim}Dv_!Rp_!Di_*H.$$ Its specified value is $$\gamma_H=n_{v,Rp_!Di_*H}\circ Rv_!Rp_!(n_{i,H})\circ Rv_!(\alpha_{p,i,H}^{-1})\circ\alpha_{v,pi,H}^{-1}\circ\alpha_{f,s,H}\circ Rf_!(n_{s,H}^{-1}),$$ with transport along $fs=vpi$ between the middle compact-support values. All normalizations and compositors in this formula are evaluated on bounded-below inputs, and all intermediate values lie in $D^+$. The isomorphism is compatible with the canonical changes of compactification and, for every $a:H'\to H$ between bounded-below objects, satisfies $$\gamma_H\circ(Rf_!Ds_!)(a)=(Dv_!Rp_!Di_*)(a)\circ\gamma_{H'}.$$ In particular this specifies the normalized chart comparison as an actual natural transformation, rather than merely asserting that its source and target are isomorphic. No right adjoints or Hom comparison are asserted.

proof.text: The existing rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus functors and their compatibility isomorphisms with the ambient derived category [def-amb-etale-compact-support] already give every intermediate value in D+. The exact immersion functors also have the existing mapDerivedCategoryPlus restrictions. The six-arrow construction etaleChartLeftCompositorPlus therefore has all its inputs and outputs in D+, and its ambient version etaleChartLeftCompositor is the specified conjugate by the endpoint compatibility maps. No new injective resolution is needed.

proof.text: Transfer the two compactification-change equations of etaleImmersionShriekNormalization [lem-sf-etale-immersion-shriek-normalization] through the fully faithful inclusion of D+. A private categorical lemma identifies composition with fullyFaithfulCancelRight with cancellation of the whiskered composition. Expanding PlusιIso cancels the adjacent compatibility map and its inverse. This gives chartOpenNormalization_change and chartClosedNormalization_change for the already specified normalizations.

proof.text: Write etaleChartCompactSupportCompositor as horizontal composition of the two changes to the globally chosen compactifications, followed by the recorded canonical compositor and the change to the supplied composite compactification. The horizontal interchange law and the comparison cocycle [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] yield its change-of-choice square. For etaleChartCompactSupportTransport, eliminate the morphism equality and apply the same cocycle on both sides.

proof.text: Invert the open-normalization square, compose it horizontally with the identity square for the f factor, then paste the (s,f) compositor square, the transport square, the inverse (i≫p,v) compositor square, the inverse (i,p) compositor square whiskered with the v comparison, the closed-normalization square whiskered with the p and v comparisons, and the v-normalization square whiskered with the fixed closed direct image and the p comparison. The private square lemmas prove that inversion, horizontal composition and vertical pasting preserve commutativity. Intermediate comparisons cancel. This proves chartLeftCompositorPlus_change with exactly the two endpoint comparisons.

proof.text: Whisker the D+ compatibility equation by the inclusion into the ambient derived category. Conjugate its source and target by the endpoint compatibility maps used to define etaleChartLeftCompositor. Expanding rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusιIso and cancelling adjacent inverses gives exactly the second conjunct of etaleChartLeftCompositor_spec, for all eight new compactifications. The exact functor mapDerivedCategoryPlus is its restriction, so its included map is the ambient map.
